senses.gloss: (b. h.) to tear, split; esp. to rend the garment in mourning.
units: Kel. XVI, 5 עד שיִקְרְעֶנּוּ (Mish. ed. שיַקְרִיעֶנּוּ Hif.) until he tears the bale open.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:15">M. Kat. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>על כל … אינו קוֹרֵעַ אלא עליון</he> for all dead (except parents) … one must rend only the upper garment.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>האשה קוֹרַעַת וכ׳</he> a woman (mourning for her parents) rends the lower garment and puts it back in its place, and then rends the upper garment.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60a:16">Snh. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>אחד השומע … חייב לִקְרוֹעַ</he> both he that hears a blasphemy directly, and he that hears it from one that heard it (and reports as witness before court) must rend his garment; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קָרוּעַ</he>; pl. <he>קְרוּעִים</he>, <he>קְרוּעִין</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:18">M. Kat. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>היוצא בבגד ק׳ וכ׳</he> he that marches before a corpse with a garment rent (for a previous case) robs (deceives) the dead and the living.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:4">Ib.ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Kings 2:12">II Kings II, 12</cite>) <he>ק׳ ועומדים לשנים</he> remaining always rent in two; ib. 22ᵇ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4); Snh. l. c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:20">M. Kat. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ואין מְקָרְעִין בפניו</he> you must not rend your garment in his (the sick man’s) presence.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>מקרעין לקטן וכ׳</he> we rend a minor’s garment in order to make him feel sad; <cite ref="Moed Katan 14b">ib. 14ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:6">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבעה … מקרעין גזר וכ׳</he> four things cause an evil decree passed on man to be torn (cancelled), they are: charity, prayer &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. גָּרַע) to scrape, to mark the outlines of letters by abrasion.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 19b:1">Gitt. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>עדים … מקרעין להם וכ׳</he> for witnesses that know not how to sign their names, grooves are made on blank paper, and they fill the grooves out with ink; <cite ref="Gittin 9b">ib. 9ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. II, 44ᵇ top <he>ומְקָרֵעַ</he>; [Tosaf. to <cite ref="Gittin 9b">Gitt. 9ᵇ</cite>: you cut the names out on blank paper and put it on the document, and the witnesses fill the cuts out].
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:8">Tosef. Sabb. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:8">XII</cite>), 8, contrad. fr. <cite ref="T01092"><he>רשם</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be torn; to be cut open, be operated upon by a section.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:6">Yeb. VIII, 6</cite>, a. e. <he>טומטום שנ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="I00178"><he>טוּמְטוּם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 42b:16">Bekh. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יִקָּרֵעַ וכ׳</he> he may have an operation performed, and be found a eunuch; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 11:1">Tosef. Yeb. XI, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 83b:7">Yeb. 83ᵇ</cite>.

B. Bath. 168ᵇ נ׳ פסול נִתְקָרֵעַ כשר if a document is found torn, it is invalid; if it appears torn by accident, it is valid as evidence; ib. נ׳ קֶרַע של בית דין נתק׳ וכ׳ miḳrʿa refers to the rent as made in court for cancellation, nithḳareʿa refers to a rent different from the manner customary in court; Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ; a. e.
